payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed methods on how gazetteer resources are built from the Wikidata knowledge base, including the processing of entity types and filtering based on popularity.

claims.text: Gazetteer resources are built from Wikidata by processing official dumps into tuples of entity and type based on the 'instance_of' triplet.
Entities in Wikidata are associated with sitelink counts, which are used to filter and retain the most popular types for each entity in the gazetteer.
Wikidata is preferred over Wikipedia for building gazetteers due to its larger size and structured format, which provides more reliable data.
